says: A person binds this device's key and the checkout, registers the repository's memory source, publishes an environment edition for this repository whose memory policy names that source, and adopts it. A preparation that names the environment without its adoption evidence is refused at admission; one resting on the adoption is composed, with no memory frontier yet. The owner then reads records 12 to 18 of a session transcript, a packaged local adapter captures a memory entry from them, and a candidate choice from that capture is stored. The capture and the candidate are drafts: neither names a receipt, neither moves the memory source's head, and the preparation composed again afterwards is the same composition as before. A review-only publication of the choice (pure_preview) is previewed and writes nothing. Only the destination's own commit of that exact choice at the memory source names a receipt and moves the head; it returns the committed record, the revision holding it and the candidate promoted with that receipt. Adoption stays a separate act: the commit adopts nothing, and the preparation composed after it, under the adoption made before, is the first to observe the memory source at the committed head.
